It applies specifically to these employees within the Directorate of Transport and Mass Transit in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa who were holding posts at the time of commencement. The legislation deems such employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis subject to verification of qualifications, while establishing conditions regarding seniority, service promotion quotas, and the requirement for publication in the Official Gazette.

administering_body: Home and Tribal Affairs Department of the Government of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

The Act determines seniority based on continuous officiating service and age, granting overriding effect to its provisions over inconsistent laws.

title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Youth Development Commission Act, 2019

The Commission comprises various ex-officio members, nominated representatives from civil society, media, academia, and youth organizations, along with a Secretary. Its functions include monitoring youth policy implementation, suggesting improvements, facilitating public-private partnerships, and maintaining ethical standards. The Commission is supported by the Tourism, Sports, Culture, Archaeology, Museums and Youth Affairs Department and must submit an annual progress report to the Provincial Assembly.

It facilitates private sector investment and establishes mechanisms for generation, transmission, distribution, and regulation of electric power within the province. The legislation creates a Policy Board and Executive Committee to manage PEDO's functions, establishes the PEDO Fund for financing operations, and repeals the previous 1993 Act and a 2020 Ordinance.

The Act outlines procedures for complaints, including preliminary assessments, hearings, and the option to refer complex matters to Civil Courts. Additionally, it provides for compensation equivalent to market rent if a woman is deprived of property use.
